source_title: Brewers complete underdog story with maiden World Series title
source_excerpt:
The Milwaukee Brewers have won the World Series for the first time. ( Getty Images: Carmen Mandato )
The small-ball Milwaukee Brewers, playing in the smallest market in the majors, are World Series champions for the first time.
Young ace Jacob Misiorowski threw 5 2/3 scoreless innings, rookie Cooper Pratt had two more hits and two runs batted in (RBIs), and the Brewers beat the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 in Game 5 to set off a long-awaited celebration among thousands of Brewers fans in attendance at Tropicana Field.
"It's the best feeling ever. All of our fans are here. I know the city's waited a long, long time for this," Milwaukee captain Christian Yelich said.
"We're so happy to bring it home to them. I can't wait to get back there and celebrate."
World Series MVP William Contreras hit an RBI double and Misiorowski allowed just two hits before leaving the game because of a right calf cramp. He got a standing ovation from the Brew-Crew fans, who took over the section behind Milwaukee's dugout for the last three games.
The 22-year-old Pratt set a series rookie record with six straight hits before a sacrifice fly in the sixth. Jackson Chourio set a five-game series record with 11 hits.
"This is one of the greatest moments of my life. Oh my gosh. It doesn't even feel real," said Pratt, who made his major league debut in June.
"This is surreal. It only took four months."
The championship comes in the 58th season for a franchise that began as the Seattle Pilots in 1969 and moved to Milwaukee the following year. The Brewers' only previous trip to the World Series in 1982 ended in heartbreak when they blew a 3-1 lead in the sixth inning of Game 7 and lost 6-3 to the St. Louis Cardinals.
But this team displayed the toughness and resilience of 67-year-old manager Pat Murphy, who survived a heart attack in 2020 and was the NL Manager of the Year in his first two full seasons at the helm in 2024 and 2025.
"This group of guys right here, the 2026 team, will be remembered forever — and they deserve that because they were a team," Murphy said.
"When you talk about this team, you've got to talk about people who care about each other. They're not worried about their own stats. No-one cares about that. They care about coming together and winning tonight."
hi_body:
मिलwaukee Brewers ने गेम 5 में Tampa Bay Rays को 4-1 से हराकर अपने इतिहास का पहला World Series खिताब जीत लिया है। मेजर लीग के सबसे छोटे मार्केट वाले इस फ्रेंचाइजी ने यह ऐतिहासिक सफलता हासिल की है।

युवा गेंदबाज Jacob Misiorowski ने 5 2/3 पारियों तक कोई रन नहीं दिया और दाएं पैर की पिंडली में ऐंठन के कारण मैदान छोड़ने से पहले केवल दो हिट दिए। रूकी Cooper Pratt ने दो हिट और दो आरबीआई बनाए, जिससे उन्होंने लगातार छह हिट्स का सीरीज रूकी रिकॉर्ड कायम किया। इसके अलावा, Jackson Chourio ने पांच मैचों की सीरीज में 11 हिट्स का रिकॉर्ड बनाया और William Contreras ने World Series MVP का खिताब हासिल किया।

## एक ऐतिहासिक फ्रेंचाइजी मील का पत्थर

* **चैंपियनशिप की सफलता:** यह जीत 58 साल के इतिहास में फ्रेंचाइजी का पहला World Series खिताब है, जिसकी शुरुआत 1969 में Seattle Pilots के रूप में हुई थी और अगले साल यह मिलwaukee स्थानांतरित हो गई थी।
* **पिछली निराशा दूर:** इस फ्रेंचाइजी की एकमात्र पूर्व World Series उपस्थिति 1982 में थी, जो St. Louis Cardinals के खिलाफ गेम 7 में हार के साथ समाप्त हुई थी।
* **मैनेजर का शानदार नेतृत्व:** टीम का मार्गदर्शन 67 वर्षीय मैनेजर Pat Murphy ने किया, जो 2024 और 2025 में एनएल मैनेजर ऑफ द ईयर रहे थे और 2020 में दिल का दौरा पड़ने के बाद उबरे थे।

## व्यावहारिक निहितार्थ और सत्यापन

चैंपियनशिप के विवरण को सत्यापित करने के लिए प्रशंसक आधिकारिक मेजर लीग बेसबॉल कवरेज, टीम के आंकड़े और Tropicana Field से प्रसारित रिपोर्टों की समीक्षा कर सकते हैं। मिलwaukee लौटने की तैयारी कर रही टीम का जश्न मनाने के लिए प्रशंसक बड़ी संख्या में एकत्र हुए थे।

en_body:
The Milwaukee Brewers have captured their maiden World Series title, defeating the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 in Game 5 to cap off a historic run for the majors' smallest-market franchise. 

Young pitcher Jacob Misiorowski delivered 5 2/3 scoreless innings, allowing just two hits before departing due to a right calf cramp. Rookie Cooper Pratt contributed two hits and two RBIs, capping off a remarkable stretch that included a series rookie record of six straight hits. Meanwhile, teammate Jackson Chourio set a five-game series record with 11 hits, and William Contreras earned World Series MVP honors following an RBI double.

## A Historic Franchise Milestone

* **Championship Breakthrough:** The victory marks the first World Series title in the 58-year history of the franchise, which originated as the Seattle Pilots in 1969 before relocating to Milwaukee.
* **Past Heartbreak Erased:** The franchise's only prior World Series appearance occurred in 1982, ending in a Game 7 loss to the St. Louis Cardinals.
* **Managerial Resilience:** The team was led by 67-year-old manager Pat Murphy, the NL Manager of the Year in 2024 and 2025 who recovered from a 2020 heart attack.

## Practical Implications and Verification

Fans looking to verify details of the championship can review official Major League Baseball coverage, team statistics, and archived broadcast reports from the event at Tropicana Field. Supporters celebrated the long-awaited milestone as the team prepares to return home to Milwaukee.
